<thought>We need a template that corresponds to the retrosynthetic step of forming an amide from a carboxylic acid and an amine (coupling agent). We'll search the template catalog using the forward reaction criteria: breaking an aliphatic carboxylic acid, forming an amide, breaking a C-O bond, and forming a C-N bond. This should return relevant templates; we can then pick the first one and return its mapped reaction SMILES and template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
